name: R2-D2-style talking
description: Short sine beeps at random pitches with random gaps (syllables); each beep bends upward by a random amount via VCO 1 as a fast LFO into VCO 2's FM. Randomness lives in the Tidal pattern (see 'tidal').
tidal: d1 $ degradeBy 0.35 $ n (segment 16 $ (0.37 <~ irand 24) + 12) # s "scstd" # o1lf 1 # o1lvl 0 # o2wave 3 # o2lvl 1 # vcalvl 1 # aratk 0.003 # arrel 0.03 # erel 0.03 # vcfcut 6000 # vcfenv 0 # vcfdrive 0 # drift 0 # o1lfrate (range 4 30 $ 0.13 <~ rand) # o2fm (range 0 0.2 $ 0.71 <~ rand) # legato (range 0.4 0.9 $ 0.53 <~ rand)
